# Reviewed under AGENTS.md
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def flatten(x: Any) -> list[Any]:
    """Flatten arbitrarily nested lists and tuples into one flat list, in order.

    Only lists and tuples are recursed into; strings, bytes, dicts and every other
    value are treated as leaves and appended to the result as-is.
    """
    out: list[Any] = []
    _flatten_into(x, out)
    return out


def _flatten_into(x: Any, out: list[Any]) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, (list, tuple)):
        for item in x:
            _flatten_into(item, out)
    else:
        out.append(x)
